Title: Ayaan's Day

Cast

1. Ayaan - 10 years, son
Look: striped T-shirt, brown trousers
2. Pallavi - 38 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans
3. Sharda - 65 years, grandmother
Look: pale blue saree, white hair
4. Rishabh - 8 years, friend
Look: red T-shirt, jeans

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The bedroom - a big bed, a wooden cupboard
3. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
4. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Ayaan stands in the courtyard. Pallavi and Sharda stand near him.]

Pallavi: "Let's do something fun today."

[A hailstorm begins.]

Ayaan (excited): "This is amazing!"

[Hailstones pound the ground.]

Ayaan: "And then?"

Scene 2: The bedroom - Day

Pallavi: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan yawns loudly.]

Ayaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Ayaan stretches his arms above his head.]

Ayaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Ayaan goes to bed and falls asleep.]

Ayaan: "Show me too!"

[Ayaan sits on the edge of the bed.]

Ayaan: "Mom, are you okay?"

Scene 3: The living room - Day

[Ayaan stands in the living room. Pallavi and Rishabh stand near him.]

Ayaan: "What a nice place."

[Ayaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Pallavi: "Careful!"

[Ayaan sits down on a chair.]

Ayaan: "Oh wow!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

[Ayaan stands in the park. Pallavi stands near him.]

Ayaan: "Let's begin."

[Ayaan throws the ball to Mother.]

Ayaan: "Okay, Mom."

[Ayaan catches the ball.]

Pallavi: "Ayaan, look at this."

[Ayaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Ayaan: "Slowly, take it easy."

[Ayaan feeds the birds.]

Pallavi (gently): "That was such a fun day!"
